tools.name: prepare_booking
tools.description: Create a fresh exact-date quote and secure hosted checkout link. Share the link with the guest for price review, details and payment approval. This tool never books, charges, or accepts card details. Its capability lets this agent check only this quote's booking status.

tools.name: get_booking_status
tools.description: Read the coarse status of the exact checkout prepared by this agent. Requires its private booking capability. Returns no guest, card, PaymentIntent, or reservation identifiers.

tools.name: complete_booking
tools.description: Resume the site's existing reservation finalizer only after the guest approved and authorized payment in hosted checkout. This cannot create or authorize a payment. Completion is controlled by a server flag; check status to follow an in-progress checkout.

tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Search Portland rentals across up to five date windows with verified layout, amenity, traveler-fit, accommodation-only price, rating, and neighborhood evidence. Dated results are live-bookable only. Use search_priced_availability when a traveler provides one date range and needs confirmed base price

tools.name: search_priced_availability
tools.description: Search Stay Portland's live availability for one required date range and return up to six exact base quotes per page. Use this first when a traveler provides dates and asks for options, full prices, fees, taxes, a budget comparison, or checkout links. Each result includes the home, accommodation, cl

tools.name: compare_properties
tools.description: Render a visual, source-grounded comparison for two to five listing ids or slugs selected from search_properties. Preserves the requested order and returns public listing profiles.

tools.name: suggest_alternate_dates
tools.description: For one live listing, find the closest calendar-confirmed stays with the same length when preferred dates do not work. Results are not priced; call get_quote for the final total.

tools.name: get_collection_overview
tools.description: Public portfolio overview: live home count, Portland neighborhoods, direct-booking advantages, policies, and the no-payment tool boundary.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Full profile for one listing by Guesty id or slug: specs, amenities, rules, prices.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Live all-in quote (nights + cleaning + taxes) and a checkout URL. Hand the guest the URL; never collect card details.

tools.name: get_reviews
tools.description: Recent guest reviews — for one listing (by Guesty id or slug) or across the whole collection. Text, rating, and month+year only.

tools.name: shortlist_property
tools.description: Save one property to the guest's list for this conversation, or drop it with remove: true. The result carries a sessionToken — reuse that exact token on every later shortlist_property and get_shortlist call in this conversation. Never read the token out to the guest; refer to it only as "your saved

tools.name: get_shortlist
tools.description: List every property saved in this conversation. Pass the sessionToken returned by shortlist_property; refer to it with the guest only as "your saved list".

tools.name: get_policies
tools.description: Canonical Stay Portland policies: fees, cancellation, pets, check-in, taxes, parking, house rules.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_booking, search_priced_availability, get_quote, get_reviews · Private data: get_booking_status, shortlist_property · Public sink: prepare_booking · Destructive: shortlist_property.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_booking, search_priced_availability, get_quote, get_reviews · Private data: get_booking_status, shortlist_property · Public sink: prepare_booking · Destructive: shortlist_property

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_properties" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
